search_explanation: Listed every file under agent/ and grepped for image:, FROM, cosign, sha256. Read the Deployment, Kyverno ClusterPolicy, CI workflow, Dockerfile and release manifest in full. The team builds and deploys its own container image, so the N/A condition does not apply.
note: Digest pinning, pinned keyless identity, provenance conditions and enforce-mode admission are all present, but the admission verifier's patch level (Kyverno 1.15.2, embedded cosign) cannot be shown to be at or above 2.6.2/3.0.4 from the repo, so the result is unclear.

checks.note: The only deployed container image is pinned by digest. Both Dockerfile base images are also pinned with @sha256. No Helm, compose or Terraform files exist. The CI tag push (agent:${{ github.sha }}) is a build output, not a deployed reference.
